faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 64 vacancies: 10 MLHP/CHO/MO/Palle Dawakhana, 4 Lab Technician Gr-II, 1 Counselor CHC NCD Clinic, 1 Physiotherapist/Occupational Therapist, 31 Staff Nurse, 10 ANM and 3 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to O/o DM&HO Medak, by in person or registered post, to reach by 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/BC/EWS 5 years, Ex-Servicemen 5 years, NCC 5 years, PH 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 40000/29000 for MLHP/CHO/MO/Palle Dawakhana, 27300 for Lab Technician Gr-II, 19500 for Counselor CHC NCD Clinic, 33750 for Physiotherapist/Occupational Therapist, 29900 for Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MBBS/BAMS/B.Sc Nursing, B.Sc Nursing/GNM, Any Degree, DMLT/MLT, B Pharmacy/D Pharmacy, MBA Health Administration, SSC + MPHW, BPT, Graduate/Intermediate Science. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026 besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications received after due date rejected. Selection by District Health Society under District Collector.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for DM&HO Medak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Merit List. Document Verification. Rule of Reservation. Selection on merit basis following Rule of Reservations.
